sampling: every training row once in each independently shuffled epoch; tail batches weighted by actual rows
budget_basis: 50-step training-only probe median 2.6493413 seconds; two-epoch pure training estimate 131.4 minutes; no automatic extension

calibration.usage: after passing development only; action NLL temperature then largest accepted coverage with >=95% observed accuracy and zero human misses, false refusals, unavailable retrieval; defer unexecuted

final: fixed candidate and same-preparation baseline only after calibration freeze; no selection or retraining
scope: text-only component; no learned tool arguments, backend calls, deployed changes, Jev requests or multimodal claims
